subject: Backend Engineer, Payments: Jordan Reyes
body:
Hello Northwind Pay hiring team,

Northwind Pay's July post-mortem on the card retry spike describes the same kind of failure I fixed at Tidewater Freight in 2025. There, retries were piling up behind one slow partner bank. I added per-bank retry budgets, and duplicate charge complaints fell from about 30 a week to 3.

I'm applying for the Backend Engineer, Payments role. For the last 4 years I've built Go payment services at Tidewater Freight, and I led the mandate retry service, which handles about 1 million requests a day.

My tailored resume is attached, and my notice period is 30 days. If the retry design is useful to go through, I'm happy to do that in an interview.

Regards,
